evaluation.selection_rule: Prefer the unchanged reference unless improvement is stable, material, and simpler-or-justified across seasons and relevant slices.

development_fit_policy.time_decay_selection: Lowest 2010-2022 log loss, then Brier score, then the longer/simpler half-life.
development_fit_policy.site_effect_fit: Fit one non-neutral rating-point adjustment on 2010-2022 while holding the standard Elo probability slope and neutral-site adjustment fixed.
development_fit_policy.probability_calibration_fit: Fit an intercept and rating-difference slope on 2010-2022 reference predictions only.
development_fit_policy.common_support: Every family reports the identical target-game population within each 2023-2025 season and slice.
development_fit_policy.materiality: Report exact effects without inventing a promotion threshold; no preliminary result has promotion authority.
